# Vaishnavi Kumari

> Vaishnavi Kumari is a senior content writer, editor and SEO strategist based in Ahmedabad, India. She has 4+ years of experience ranking content for edtech, tech and cybersecurity brands, leads content and SEO teams, and works remotely with brands in India and the US (UK teams welcome). On her site she calls herself "momo-fuelled content, SEO & marketing expert". She is a former news anchor and was one of the youngest contestants on Kaun Banega Crorepati (KBC) Season 14.

## Hire her
Available for freelance and consulting work, remote: content writer for hire, editor for hire, content strategist and content consultant for hire, SEO consultant. Contact by email or LinkedIn above, or book a call on vaishnavikumari.com.

## What she does
- Content writing and editing: long-form articles, blogs, service pages, educational and technical content
- SEO: keyword research, topical maps and clusters (Ahrefs, SEMrush), on-page SEO, internal linking, Google Search Console reviews, content refreshes
- Content strategy and team leadership: hired and trained a team of 6-7 writers, built review workflows, led video creators
- Marketing: organic campaigns across web and social, content-led PR
- UX and design review: catches UI, icon and layout issues; works in Figma with designers
- 1:1 sessions: SEO content audits, breaking into content writing, draft reviews, building a first content team

- Testbook, Content Writer Intern (Jul 2021 - Feb 2022): 150 articles a month, 80% in the top 5
